{{Top|leg}}
The '''Delephran militia''' was a security force based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Delephran]]. The militia hired [[Andrephan Stormcaller]] to train its commanders and participated in the [[Piracy Scouring]] of the [[Vexta Belt]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] absorbed the Delephran militia into is own forces during its military expansion.
